usefulness.rationale: The dossier gives a strong picture of who Achim Steiner is: Brazilian-German national born in Brazil, UNDP Administrator 2017–2025 (Oxford Martin profile: 'served as United Nations Under-Secretary General and Administrator of the United Nations Development Programme (2017 -2025)'), UNEP Executive Director 2006–2016, earlier IUCN Director-General, World Commission on Dams Secretary-General, UNON Director-General, Oxford Martin School director and now Senior Fellow, PPE/SOAS education, awards, and current board roles (HSC chair, CCICED, AGORA, Climate Works Foundation, German Chancellor's Council). However, the dossier never states what it does not know, and its current-role picture is internally contradictory: many claims assert he 'is'/'now serves as' UNDP Administrator even though the retained account ends the tenure in June 2025 and he has moved to Oxford Martin School and other roles. A block of claims about Helen Clark (previous UNDP Administrator) is also mixed into his dossier. Meeting prep is possible on career, expertise and current affiliations, but a reader could easily walk away believing he still runs UNDP.
